# Remko's Blog

> About things I break, build, reverse, package, automate, and occasionally understand.

Personal technical blog by Remko Weijnen since 2007: Windows internals, application delivery (Citrix, VDI, SBC), reverse engineering, security, packaging, automation, Delphi and PowerShell, Home Assistant and AI-assisted development. Posts are practical write-ups and lab notes. Quote with a link to the post.

## Pages

- [About](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/about/): who writes this blog, and the privacy statement
- [Tools](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/tools/): browser-based and downloadable tools, each with the post that explains it
- [Contact](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/contact/): contact form
- [Archives](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/archives/): all posts by date
- [Sitemap](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/sitemap.xml)

## Posts

- [Claude Code hooks for path mangling on Windows: an AI fix for an AI problem](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2026/11/06/claude-code-hooks-path-mangling-windows/): Claude Code on Windows kept running python3, /c/ paths and > nul in Git Bash, so I had Claude write hooks to fix them. Three months of logs showed which fixes still help, which got in the way, and why v2 now parses each command to tell a command from text about a command.
- [Video freezes after a few frames in both Chrome and Firefox: a troubleshooting post-mortem](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2026/11/04/video-freezes-chrome-firefox/): Video in both Chrome and Firefox froze after a few frames or didn't play at all, until a reboot. It looked like DRM. A post-mortem of the troubleshooting, the real cause, a fix without a reboot and a probe to diagnose it.
- [Stay a while, stay forever: a C64 demo for VIPP Malta](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2026/10/30/breadbox-in-malta/): At the 10th Parallels VIPP Summit in Malta, Freek Berson brought a Commodore 64. It sent me down a rabbit hole: a C64 demo and an Impossible Mission tribute for VIPP, built with Claude Code and running on the real hardware.
- [Deriving an SBOM from closed firmware such as Citrix NetScaler](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2026/10/29/sbom-from-closed-firmware/): Vendors of closed appliances rarely ship an SBOM. Can you derive one from the firmware yourself, so the next "am I affected?" is a quick lookup instead of a reverse engineering session? I tried, with NetScaler as the test case.
- [Did Citrix really fix PHP2Shell on NetScaler? Taking the patched firmware apart](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2026/10/27/netscaler-php2shell-citrix-patch/): Citrix released NetScaler builds that fix PHP2Shell, but they still report PHP 8.1.34. Jan Tytgat and I compared the patched firmware with the old one to see what Citrix actually changed.
- [PHP2Shell on NetScaler: to ASLR or not to ASLR?](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2026/10/22/netscaler-php2shell-aslr/): Most public PHP2Shell exploits get stuck on ASLR. NetScaler runs on FreeBSD 11.4, which is end of life. So does NetScaler have ASLR? I took the firmware apart again to find out.
- [Does PHP2Shell reach NetScaler? Taking the firmware apart to find out](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2026/10/21/netscaler-php2shell/): PHP fixed two critical pre-auth RCE bugs (PHP2Shell). NetScaler 14.1 ships PHP 8.1.34, which is end of life. I pulled the binaries out of the firmware to see if it is vulnerable, and from where it can be reached.
- [Outlook hangs at startup: debugging it together with AI](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2026/10/21/outlook-hangs-at-startup/): Outlook (Classic) kept hanging at startup, so I let Claude debug it with procdump, cdb and IDA. The TeamViewer add-in pulled the trigger, but the real cause is how Outlook waits for a sign-in.
- [Quip hangs with waiting cursor](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2023/02/27/quip-hangs-with-waiting-cursor/): Diagnosing why the Quip desktop app launches to a white screen with a stalled busy indicator on a virtual desktop and how to get it working again.
- [Get registry key name from a handle](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2022/10/18/get-registry-key-name-from-a-handle/): Resolve the full registry key name from an open key handle in C# using the NtQueryKey API with KeyNameInformation, useful when hooking RegQueryValue.
- [Downloading a Video from the Web without Browser Extension](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2022/10/17/downloading-a-video-from-the-web-without-browser-extension/): Downloading segmented .ts streaming video from sites like Dumpert without a browser extension by capturing the segments and re-encoding to one file.
- [Get Rid of the Office 2019 Licensing Nag Screen](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2022/10/11/get-rid-of-the-office-2019-licensing-nag-screen/): Suppress the Office 2019 EULA nag screen with an HKLM registry value found via Process Monitor, avoiding a reinstall through the Office Deployment Tool.
- [The AWS Access Key Id you provided does not exist in our records using AWS PowerShell Cmdlets](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2022/06/17/the-aws-access-key-id-you-provided-does-not-exist-in-our-records-using-aws-powershell-cmdlets/): Resolve the AWS Access Key Id does not exist error in the AWS PowerShell cmdlets after switching accounts, covering IAM user creation and API key setup.
- [Ubuntu crash when pasting files from VMware](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2022/06/15/ubuntu-crash-when-pasting-files-from-vmware/): Stop Nautilus crashing when pasting host files into an Ubuntu 22.04 VMware Workstation VM by switching the login session from Ubuntu (Wayland) to Ubuntu on Xorg.
- [No internet access from Edge and other Microsoft apps](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2019/10/16/no-internet-access-from-edge-and-other-microsoft-apps/): Edge, the Microsoft Store and Outlook fail with no internet while Firefox and Chrome work fine, traced to a connection marked as a Public network on Windows 10.
- [DesktopAppConverter : error 'E_MANIFEST_USE_DEFAULT_VALUE_FAILED](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2018/03/22/desktopappconverter-error-e_manifest_use_default_value_failed/): Debugging the DesktopAppConverter E_MANIFEST_USE_DEFAULT_VALUE_FAILED error by tracing PackageName validation in ManifestOps.ps1 with the PowerShell ISE.
- [signtool sign returns error 0x800700C1](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2018/01/19/signtool-sign-returns-error-0x800700c1/): Signtool error 0x800700C1 signing an APPX often means a bundled binary has a corrupt signature; find it and strip the bad Security Directory with CFF Explorer.
- [Case of the Crashing Task Scheduler](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2018/01/18/case-crashing-task-scheduler/): On Windows 10 1709 the Task Scheduler service crashes with Error 1067 and an empty MMC snap-in, traced through the TaskScheduler Operational event log.

- [How to remove Windows.old folder](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2018/01/16/remove-windows-old-folder/): Deleting a stubborn Windows.old folder that Disk Cleanup and Explorer cannot remove by using the \\?\ long-path prefix to delete a locked Cortana package subfolder.

- [RAD Studio Tokyo 10.2(.2) Data Collection](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2017/12/18/rad-studio-tokyo-10-2-2-data-collection/): RAD Studio 10.2.2 hides an opt-in Embarcadero Customer Experience Program behind an Options button in the ESD installer, quietly enabling broad data sharing by default.
- [Change NetScaler Password Hash from SHA1 to SHA512](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2017/12/13/change-netscaler-password-hash-sha1-sha512/): One NetScaler stores its password hash as SHA1 after upgrades while a reinstalled peer uses SHA512; here is why they differ and how to move SHA1 to SHA512.
- [Get Windows 10 Version Number with PowerShell](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2017/04/04/get-windows-10-version-number-powershell/): Why the Windows version APIs changed after Windows 8.1 for Application Compatibility, and how to read the true Windows 10 version number with PowerShell.

- [Locking a workstation - part 1](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/12/13/locking-a-workstation-part-1/): How winlogon.exe registers with win32k.sys via RegisterLogonProcess and the SAS window, and what LockWorkstation actually does under the Win32 API.
- [Converting a volume name to a device name](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/12/10/converting-a-volume-name-to-a-device-name/): Convert a Windows volume name like \\?\Volume{GUID}\ to a device name like \Device\HarddiskVolume1 using QueryDosDevice after stripping the prefix and trailing slash.
- [Commandline tool to change drive letter assignment](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/12/09/commandline-tool-to-change-drive-letter-assignment/): ChDrvLetter is a command-line tool that reassigns drive letters by volume label, fixing the drive letter reset that sysprep causes on prepared images.
- [Windows 2003 X64 Terminal Server Patch](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/12/09/windows-2003-x64-terminal-server-patch/): A patch for the CRAPolicy::Logon function in termsrv.dll enabling more than two concurrent Remote Administration sessions on Windows Server 2003 x64 build 3790.3959.
- [New Universal Patch Method](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/12/09/new-universal-patch-method/): Moving from VPatch's strict MD5 checks to a hex search-and-replace patcher so binary patches apply across different builds and language versions.
- [Executing a Fast User Switch programmatically - part 2](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/11/26/executing-a-fast-user-switch-programmatically-part-2/): Build a Credential Server for Fast User Switching using a GUID-named pipe registered under the Winlogon Credentials key with normalized UNICODE_STRING data.
- [Executing a Fast User Switch programmatically - part 1](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/11/26/executing-a-fast-user-switch-programmatically-part-1/): How Fast User Switching works internally on Windows XP Terminal Server sessions, using per-session winlogon.exe and the WinStationConnect API to switch users.
- [Terminal Server Internals](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/11/19/terminal-server-internals/): How termsrv, csrss and winsrv.dll communicate over the SmSsWinStationApiPort LPC port and WinStationLpcThread threads to service Terminal Server sessions.
- [Switch between Java Versions](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/11/12/switch-between-java-versions/): Run Java 1.5 and 1.6 side by side per application on a Citrix server without HKLM write access by controlling the ssv.dll IE add-on and UseJava2Iexplorer.
- [RDP Session with Local Taskbar visible](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/11/02/rdp-session-with-local-taskbar-visible/): A small tool uses SystemParametersInfo and GetSystemMetrics to compute the correct desktop size so an mstsc RDP session fills the screen while keeping the local taskbar visible.
- [Microsoft Tech-Ed IT Professionals 2008](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/10/24/microsoft-tech-ed-it-professionals-2008/): Remko Weijnen is attending Microsoft Tech-Ed EMEA IT Professionals 2008 in Barcelona and invites readers to meet up at the conference.
- [Application crashes while opening helpfile](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/10/23/application-crashes-while-opening-helpfile/): An app crash opening a CHM help file is traced to an outdated psapi.dll shipped in the application directory shadowing the correct system32 version; renaming it fixes the crash.
- [Patch Windows 2008 Terminal Server to allow more than 2 concurrent sessions](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/10/21/patch-windows-2008-terminal-server-to-allow-more-than-2-concurrent-sessions/): Step-by-step VPatch instructions to patch termsrv.dll on 32-bit English Windows 2008 for unlimited Remote Administration Terminal Server sessions.
- [Prevent rename or removal of the My Documents icon on the desktop](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/09/02/prevent-rename-or-removal-of-the-my-documents-icon-on-the-desktop/): Using Process Monitor to trace the HideDesktopIcons registry keys and set per-GUID DWORD values that lock the My Documents desktop icon against rename or deletion.
- [Applications tab in taskmanager is empty #2](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/09/02/applications-tab-in-taskmanager-is-empty-2/): Excluding taskmgr.exe from the Citrix Multiple Monitor Hook via an Exclude REG_SZ value preserves multi-monitor support, and adding mstsc.exe fixes nested RDP window issues.
- [Applications tab in taskmanager is empty](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/09/01/applications-tab-in-taskmanager-is-empty/): An empty Applications tab in Task Manager on Citrix Presentation Server 4.5 is fixed by changing the Multiple Monitor Hook Flag registry value from 4 to 0.
- [Patch Windows 2003 Terminal Server to allow more than 2 concurrent sessions](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/08/31/patch-windows-2003-terminal-server-to-allow-more-than-2-concurrent-sessions/): Patching the CRAPolicy::Logon function in Windows 2003 Terminal Server to lift the 2-session Remote Administration limit without a license server.
- [Remko's download's](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/08/20/remkos-downloads/): A download page hosting ProfMan.zip, a utility made available for readers of Remko Weijnen's technical blog.
- [Registry editing has been disabled by your administrator (not anymore!)](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/08/12/registry-editing-has-been-disabled-by-your-administrator/): Regedit blocks access when DisableRegistryTools is set to 1; this explains how the check works and how an administrator can still inspect a user's registry keys.
- [Unattended Citrix Installation: Could not Access the datastore using the DSN file](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/06/23/error-26009-could-not-access-the-datastore-using-the-dsn-file/): Fix Citrix Presentation Server 4.5 unattended install error 26009 Could not Access the datastore using the DSN file when the echo-generated DSN file is rejected.
- [Resuming Microsoft's (Akami) Download Manager](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/06/22/resuming-microsofts-akami-download-manager/): Restarting Microsoft's Akamai Download Manager after an interrupted Volume Licensing download by making a shortcut to the Manager.exe in the short-name CONFLICT.1 folder.
- [Configuring IBM Raid controller with Altiris](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/06/17/configuring-ibm-raid-controller-with-altiris/): Configure ServeRAID-8k-l arrays on IBM x3550 and x3650 servers via Altiris, and fix the CFGRAID policies file syntax error caused by XCopy under FreeDOS.
- [Multiple Concurrent Terminal Server Sessions On Vista SP1](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/06/14/mutiple-concurrent-terminal-session-on-vista-sp1/): VPatch files for enabling concurrent Terminal Server sessions on Vista SP1, patching both termsrv.dll and lsm.exe to work around the localhost and same-user limits.
- [Terminal Server Ping Tool](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/06/13/terminal-server-ping-tool/): WTSPing is a command-line tool built on the undocumented WinStationServerPing API that verifies a Terminal or Citrix server accepts connections, unlike a network ping.
- [Script to logoff all Terminal Server sessions](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/06/09/script-to-logoff-all-terminal-server-sessions/): Logoff.exe cannot end every session at once, but logging off the RDP Listener session in TSAdmin logs off all sessions created through it before a package rollout.
- [Encrypting RDP Passwords in VB.NET](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/05/02/encrypting-rdp-passwords-in-vbnet/): Justin Shepard ports the RDP password encryption code to VB.NET, providing a ready-to-use routine for encrypting RDP connection passwords in .NET.
- [Working with bitfields in Delphi](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/05/01/working-with-bitfields-in-delphi/): Delphi has no bitfield type, so translate C bitfields using a BDS2006 record with getter/setter properties that expose the packed ULONG values as booleans.
- [Using Windows Server 2008 as a SUPER workstation OS](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/04/06/using-windows-server-2008-as-a-super-workstation-os/): Run Windows Server 2008 as a Vista replacement workstation OS, gaining Hyper-V and roughly 20 percent better performance than Vista.
- [How to deactivate Internet Explorer Enhanced Security Configuration in Windows Server 2008?](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/04/04/how-to-deactivate-internet-explorer-enhanced-security-configuration-in-windows-server-2008/): Turn off Internet Explorer Enhanced Security Configuration in Windows Server 2008 via Server Manager, separately for administrators and normal users.
- [How to install Powershell in Server 2008?](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/04/04/how-to-install-powershell-in-server-2008/): Install the PowerShell feature on Windows Server 2008, which ships with the OS but is not enabled by default, using Server Manager Add Features.
- [Microsoft Remote Server Administration Tools released](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/03/26/microsoft-remote-server-administration-tools-released/): Microsoft released Remote Server Administration Tools (RSAT) for Windows Vista SP1, enabling remote management of Windows Server 2008 roles and features.
- [New home for Jedi Apilib and Jedi Security Library](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/03/03/new-home-for-jedi-apilib-and-jedi-security-library/): A new blog has launched as the home for the JEDI ApiLib and JEDI Security Library Delphi projects.
- [How rdp passwords are encrypted 2](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/03/02/how-rdp-passwords-are-encrypted-2/): How mstsc pads RDP passwords to 512 bytes before encryption, producing a 1328-byte hash plus a single trailing zero to reach the odd 1329-byte size.
- [Vista SP1 changes to Terminal Server API](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/03/02/vista-sp1-changes-to-terminal-server-api/): Vista SP1 restores the Windows 2008 utildll implementation, so JwaWinsta Safe functions again work across all Windows versions and service packs.
- [Supporting for in loop in TObjectList descendants](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/03/02/supporting-for-in-loop-in-tobjectlist-descendants/): Enable Delphi's for-in loop on TObjectList descendants like Terminal Server session lists by implementing a GetEnumerator method and enumerator class.
- [TSAdminEx Progress](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/01/27/test-2/): A progress update on TSAdminEx showing the treeview of servers, Users and Sessions tabs, per-session traffic statistics and the Remote Address column.
- [Softpedia](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/01/25/softpedia/): Softpedia listed the LaunchRDP command line tool in its catalog and notified the author, giving users a place to rate the utility.
- [Using WTSWaitSystemEvent](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2008/01/25/using-wtswaitsystemevent/): React to Terminal Server logon, logoff and idle events with WTSWaitSystemEvent, working around duplicate events on Windows 2000 and the Vista flush bug via a small delay.
- [Why TSAdmin crashes on Windows Vista](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/12/19/why-tsadmin-crashes-on-windows-vista/): TSAdmin crashes with an access violation on Vista because the undocumented Utildll ElapsedTimeString function corrupts the stack during session enumeration.
- [Undocumented API's from Utildll](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/12/09/undocumented-apis-from-utildll/): Document undocumented Utildll.dll functions used by TSAdmin such as StrConnectState and ElapsedTimeString, and their Citrix CUtildll.dll equivalents, for the JwaWinsta unit.
- [IDA 4.9 released as freeware](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/12/09/ida-49-released-as-freeware/): Datarescue has released IDA 4.9 as freeware, the de-facto standard disassembler for hostile code analysis, vulnerability research, and reverse engineering.
- [Delphi and Terminal Server Aware](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/11/24/delphi-and-terminal-server-aware/): How to set the TSAware flag in the PE header of a Delphi executable so Terminal Server skips legacy INI and registry redirection for the app.
- [Even more undocumented Terminal Server API's uncovered](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/11/21/even-more-undocumented-terminal-server-apis-uncovered/): Uncover more undocumented winsta.dll Terminal Server APIs and WinStationQueryInformationW classes exposing passwords, Product ID and client info via the JwaWinsta unit.
- [Multiple Terminal Sessions in Windows Vista](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/11/21/multiple-terminal-session-in-windows-vista/): Overview of the termsrv.dll and Winlogon patching approach that enables multiple concurrent Terminal Server sessions on Windows Vista.
- [More undocumented Terminal Server API's](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/11/09/more-undocumented-terminal-server-apis/): New undocumented winsta.dll functions added to the Jwawinsta unit, including WinStationDisconnect, WinStationGetProcessSid and expanded WinStationQueryInformationW session data.
- [Terminal Server Client annoyances](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/11/09/terminal-server-client-annoyances/): Suppress the Remote Desktop identity verification prompt by setting AuthenticationLevelOverride to 0 under the Terminal Server Client registry key.
- [Citrix Solutions Conference 2007](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/11/08/citrix-solutions-conference-2007/): Notes from the Citrix Solutions Conference in Antwerp, including Brad Pedersen on WinFrame history and the push for public Terminal Server APIs in winsta.dll.
- [How to launch a process in a Terminal Session #2](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/11/08/how-to-launch-a-process-in-a-terminal-session-2/): RunInSession, a command-line tool that launches a process in any Terminal Session by installing itself as a LocalSystem service and calling WTSQueryUserToken.
- [JEDI Apilib and JEDI Windows Security Code Library](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/11/08/jedi-apilib-and-jedi-windows-security-code-library/): The JEDI Apilib gains a single-unit JwaWindows include model plus JWSCL, a Delphi library simplifying Win32 tokens, ACLs, security descriptors, and impersonation.
- [Encrypt RDP password in Python](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/11/05/encrypt-rdp-password-in-python/): Dirk Schmitz contributes a Python implementation for encrypting the RDP password, mirroring the earlier reverse-engineered RDP password encryption algorithm.
- [Post Views](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/11/02/post-views/): Adding view counters to WordPress posts using Lester GaMerZ Chan's Post Views plugin to track how often each article gets read.
- [Query Active Directory from Excel](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/11/01/query-active-directory-from-excel/): A custom Excel function GetAdsProp that searches any Active Directory field across the tree and returns another attribute, replacing repetitive VBS lookup scripts.
- [Google adds IMAP support to GMail](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/11/01/google-adds-imap-support-to-gmail/): Google has enabled IMAP in Gmail so clients like Outlook can read mail without local storage, alongside a raised storage limit of around 4 GB.
- [How to get Client IP Address?](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/10/31/how-to-get-client-ip-address/): Retrieve a Terminal Server client IP address by calling WTSQuerySessionInformation with WTSClientAddress and reading the address at offset 2 of WTS_CLIENT_ADDRESS.
- [New Terminal Server API's in Vista SP1](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/10/30/new-terminal-server-apis-in-vista-sp1/): The supposedly new Vista SP1 WTSConnectSession and remote control APIs are just wtsapi32.dll wrappers around undocumented winsta.dll functions present since Windows 2000.
- [Script to clear SQL Transactions logs](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/10/28/script-to-clear-sql-transactions-logs/): A VBS script that clears growing SQL Server transaction logs, useful as a post-backup job when Backup Exec with the SQL Agent leaves logs untruncated.
- [RDP Clipboard Fix](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/10/25/rdp-clipboard-fix/): Losing copy and paste across Terminal Server sessions is caused by a broken clipboard chain from misbehaving apps; RepairCBDChain.exe restores clipboard functionality.
- [TSAdminEx](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/10/23/tsadminex/): Build a TSAdmin replacement in Delphi to demonstrate the Terminal Server APIs, starting with a GUI of Mainmenu, Toolbar, Treeview and a PageControl for sessions and processes.
- [How to launch a process in a Terminal Session](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/10/20/how-to-launch-a-process-in-a-terminal-session/): Launch a process in another Terminal Session by obtaining the user token with WtsQueryUserToken from LocalSystem and passing it to CreateProcessAsUser.
- [A referral was returned from the server](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/10/19/a-referral-was-returned-from-the-server/): A referral was returned from the server appears when a VBS script queries Active Directory across domains; setting ADS_CHASE_REFERRALS on the query fixes it.
- [How rdp passwords are encrypted](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/10/18/how-rdp-passwords-are-encrypted/): Encrypt and decrypt saved mstsc RDP passwords using CryptProtectData and CryptUnprotectData, enabling programmatic creation and updating of rdp files.
- [Launch RDP from commandline](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/10/17/launch-rdp-from-commandline/): A command-line tool that launches mstsc.exe with username, password, domain, and redirection arguments and suppresses the v6 client trust dialog via registry.
- [Atheros AR5007EG - Bad WLAN performance](https://remkoweijnen.nl/blog/2007/10/16/toshiba-satellite-l40/): Fix slow, unstable WLAN on a Toshiba Satellite L40 with the Atheros AR5007EG under Vista by installing driver v7.3.1.109 v1.15 plus Microsoft Vista WLAN hotfixes.
